questions.question: What is ASML trading at right now in Amsterdam and on Nasdaq? Give each price in its own currency.
must_include: Two separate lines: ASML @ Euronext Amsterdam (XAMS) in EUR, ASML @ Nasdaq (XNAS) in USD
Quote timestamps / market state for each
No silent FX conversion; if it compares, it states the FX rate used
pitfalls: Labelling the USD price as EUR or vice versa
Using ASML.AS vs ASML symbol confusion (Yahoo)

questions.question: How did Heineken shares do over the past year?
must_include: Heineken N.V. (HEIA, XAMS, ISIN NL0000009165) in EUR
1-year % price return with start/end prices and dates
Mentions dividends not included (price return) or includes total return explicitly
pitfalls: Using Heineken Holding (HEIO, NL0000008977) instead of Heineken N.V.
Using the US OTC ADR (HEINY) in USD

questions.question: What company is ISIN NL0000009165?
must_include: Heineken N.V.
Ticker HEIA on Euronext Amsterdam, EUR

questions.question: Find ASML's latest ESEF annual report.
must_include: FY2025 annual financial report (published ~Feb 2026)
Filing date and link to the ESEF package/report (filings.xbrl.org or AFM)
LEI 724500Y6DUVHQD6OXN27 used for lookup

questions.question: What is Apple's latest 10-K, and when was it filed?
must_include: 10-K for fiscal year ended 27 Sep 2025 (FY2025)
Filed ~31 Oct 2025
Accession number / sec.gov link
Notes FY2026 10-K not yet filed (as of Sep 2026)

questions.question: According to ASML's latest annual report, how much did revenue (total net sales) grow?
must_include: FY2025 total net sales vs FY2024 (FY2024 = EUR 28,262.9m; FY2023 = EUR 27,558.5m)
Growth % computed from reported figures, in EUR
Source named: annual report (ESEF) or 20-F

questions.question: What was Apple's total revenue in its last fiscal year?
must_include: FY2025 (ended 27 Sep 2025) net sales ~USD 416.2bn
Prior year FY2024 USD 391.0bn for context optional
Source: 10-K / SEC XBRL
pitfalls: Reporting TTM or calendar-year figures as FY

questions.question: Give me a short company profile of Adyen.

Listed on Euronext Amsterdam (ADYEN, NL0012969182), EUR
Sector/industry, key facts from a tool (not memory only)

Inconsistent dates between the two series

must_include: Heineken N.V., HEIA, XAMS, NL0000009165 (not Heineken Holding)
Latest annual report FY2025 (ESEF, published ~Feb 2026) with link
Revenue figure from that report in EUR (distinguish revenue vs net revenue)
1y price return in EUR with dates
